---
title: "05 — Standardization and reusable cubes"
format: html
---

## Goal

Create reproducible reusable products from validated raw sources without destroying native information.

## Rules

- Raw files remain immutable.
- Coordinate names, calendars, units, and dimension ordering may be standardized in `cin/interim/`.
- Regridding is explicit, versioned, and justified; it never replaces native raw data.
- Prefer sensible time-chunked NetCDF (for example annual files) for interoperability; use Zarr when size/access patterns justify it.
- Avoid one-file-per-day fragmentation unless the provider or access pattern requires it.

## Required provenance

Every standardized artifact records source file checksum(s), processing function/version, target grid if any, temporal aggregation, and output checksum.
